notes: 있다 is one of the most common verbs in Korean. It is used both to say where something is located and to say that something exists or is in one's possession.
When you want to say you have something, use the pattern [noun]이/가 있다. For example, '사과가 있다' means 'There is an apple' or 'I have an apple'.
